bulleted.text:
Alcoholic beverages may be purchased at the Disneyland Resort by Guests 21 years of age or older. The documents required to verify age vary for United States residents and non-United States residents.


United States Residents

United States residents who wish to purchase an alcoholic beverage at the Disneyland Resort must present one of the following forms of identification:

•        Identification card issued by a governmental agency in the United States (Federal, State, Territory,* County, City) that contains the following:

o   Name

o   Date of birth

o   Physical description of the person

o   Photo of the person

o   Expiration date

•        Valid active United States Armed Forces ID (must include date of birth and portrait photo)

•        Valid original passport

Temporary driver’s licenses, temporary ID cards and copies of passports, driver’s licenses or ID cards are not acceptable.

* United States territories include Puerto Rico, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, United States Virgin Islands and American Samoa.


Non-United States Residents

Original passports are the only form of identification acceptable for Guests from outside the United States; non-United States driver’s licenses, ID cards, temporary ID cards and copies of ID cards are not acceptable.

copy:
Celebrate the pioneering spirit of the open road and home-style cooking at this kitschy Cars-themed café.

Diner-inspired classics, mouthwatering milkshakes and a ton of memorabilia make Flo’s V8 Cafe a priority pit stop—and Carburetor County’s most popular eatery. All of Flo’s delicious eats are served up in a jiffy, so you can fuel up on a speedy yet satisfying meal before you head out on the highway.

Nostalgic and novel at the same time, Flo’s sports all kinds of automotive touches that put you inside the Pixar movies while transporting you to a simpler time, from vintage-style gas pumps to tailpipe light fixtures to 2-toned tuck-and-roll upholstered banquettes!

Before you hit the road, be sure to check out Flo’s showroom housing mementos from her days as lead singer of the glamorous Motorama Girls—she’s fin-tastic! Another section is a museum showcasing the career of Cars racing legend Doc Hudson, also known as the Fabulous Hudson Hornet.
sections.title: Go with the Flo

copy:
Hot-rod into Flo’s V8 Cafe and refuel with a lineup of turbocharged treats that will delight racers of all ages!

Zoom into flavor with the “Big Dipper” Cheeseburger—featuring a juicy beef patty, melty American cheese, zippy B & B pickles and caramelized onions on a toasted bun, all splashed with a speedy pepperoncini cheese sauce. Pit crew members will love making a pit stop for the Winner’s Circle Chicken and Waffle, where crispy, golden-fried chicken meets a fluffy buttermilk waffle, whipped butter and a drizzle of classic maple syrup.

Shift gears for something fresh like the Fillmore Groovy Greens—a vibrant mix of romaine, kale, bean and corn salad, cucumbers, tomatoes, crispy quinoa and toasted sunflower seeds, all tossed in zesty dressing. And don’t forget to fuel up with Start Your Engine Cold Brew, blending Joffrey’s Shakin’ Jamaican™ Cold Brew with caramel syrup, house-made caramel cream and a caramel sauce drizzle. Little drivers and grown-up gearheads alike can celebrate with a Stop Sign Cream Soda Pop—a Sprite® creation topped with strawberry and coconut cream, house-made strawberry cream and strawberry-flavored flakes.

Junior members of your pit crew can turbocharge their meals with a car-shaped keepsake containing their choice of a Micro Burger, Mini Buckwheat Waffles or Mack’s Mac & Cheese.

Top off your tank with a vanilla, chocolate or strawberry shake topped with edible “road gravel”! For those Guests 21 and over, who prefer something with a little more horsepower, Brewery X’s Fender Bender IPA is ready to rev your engines.
